therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adolescent subjects with idiopathic restless legs syndrome
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in IRLS sum score and CGI Item 1 at end of maintenance period (Day 106); percentage of participants with TEAEs

results.effect_size: IRLS change from baseline: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -14.0, rotigotine 3 mg/24h -6.4, placebo -8.2
subgroup_findings: RLS-6 satisfaction with sleep: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -4.7 vs placebo -1.8
RLS-6 RLS symptoms at falling asleep: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -5.6 vs placebo -2.8
RLS-6 RLS symptoms during the night: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -2.9 vs placebo -1.0
RLS-6 RLS symptoms during the day at rest: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -3.6 vs placebo -1.4
RLS-6 RLS symptoms during the day not at rest: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -4.3 vs placebo -3.8
RLS-6 how tired or sleepy during the day: rotigotine 2 mg/24h -5.6 vs placebo -3.0
safety_signals: TEAEs occurred in 87.5% of placebo, 87.5% of rotigotine 2 mg/24h, and 71.4% of rotigotine 3 mg/24h participants
TEAEs leading to withdrawal: 12.5% placebo, 0% rotigotine 2 mg/24h, 0% rotigotine 3 mg/24h
One case of type 2 diabetes mellitus (serious AE) in rotigotine 3 mg/24h arm
Trial terminated due to sponsor decision; not a safety decision

adverse_events.term: Treatment-emergent adverse events leading to withdrawal

context.duration: Up to Week 20 (maintenance period to Day 106)
context.investigator_commentary: Sponsor decision; Not a safety decision
